_comment: Real values for tools/sync-console-live-drive.mjs (ticket 450). A TODO value SKIPs its checks, and a SKIP is not green. The write sections run only with --write, and only on the TEST stores named here: never a store that trades. The read codes P001/P002 were picked 2026-10-10 from the LOCAL POS_Server; the write and re-push stores stay TODO in the repo on purpose, so a run pointed at staging never writes to a store nobody chose for it (locally P134 was used). Ticket 460 added the mirror and agreement inputs (the read code P624 picked 2026-10-11 from the LOCAL POS_Server: a NewPos store on the mirror with judged days); the --write ones (two seeded dead letters, a repaired store-day) stay TODO for the same reason.
testStoreOnWpf: TODO: a TEST store on WPF that may be moved to the worker and handed back (--write)
testStoreForTest: TODO: a TEST store whose connection may be tested (--write)
rePushStoreCode: TODO: a worker store to PREVIEW a re-push on. Preview only: the drive never confirms a re-push

onboard.code: TODO: a new TEST store code, ^[A-Z0-9]{4}$, no Store master yet
onboard.templateStore: TODO: the store master whose payment types are copied (P001 on the stubs)
onboard.templateLocation: TODO: the sync location copied for step 2 (P001 or C011)

retryDeadLetter: TODO: --write: a SEEDED apply-stage dead letter of mirrorStoreCode, as its row id 'apply-<id>', that will apply once retried
acknowledgeDeadLetter: TODO: --write: another SEEDED dead letter of mirrorStoreCode, as 'apply-<id>' or 'pull-<id>', to acknowledge as lost
recheckStoreCode: TODO: --write: the store whose repaired day is rechecked (locally P624 was used)
recheckDay: TODO: --write: that day, yyyy-MM-dd, within D-1..D-7 and listed on its Agreement tab
